headline: EPS jumps year-over-year and more than doubles q/q
summary_short: Terumo reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥47.74, up 68.3% y/y from ¥28.37.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥47.74 rose 68.3% year-over-year from ¥28.37, and more than doubled sequentially, up 167.1% from ¥17.87 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
